units.en: Liang said to Wan and Shi, "When returning to the capital there ought to be a letter to exchange news with Zidu."
units.literal: Liang said to Wan and Shi, "When returning to the capital there ought to be a letter to exchange news with Zidu."

units.zh: 詩進曰：「孟達小子，昔事振威不忠，後又背叛先主，反覆之人，何足與書邪！」
units.en: Fei Shi said, "Meng Da is a petty man. He was disloyal when he formerly served the General Who Inspires Awe, and later he betrayed the First Sovereign as well. A man so changeable is not worth exchanging letters with!"
units.literal: Shi advanced saying, "Meng Da the petty fellow, formerly served General Who Strikes Terror disloyally, afterward again betrayed the First Sovereign—a man of back and forth—what worth to exchange letters!"

units.zh: 亮默然不答。
units.en: Zhuge Liang said nothing.
units.literal: Liang was silent and did not answer.

units.zh: 亮欲誘達以為外援，竟與達書曰：「往年南征，歲
units.en: Zhuge Liang wished to draw Meng Da in as an outside ally and ultimately wrote him a letter: "In former years, during the southern campaign, before the year
units.literal: Liang wished to entice Da to be an external aid; in the end wrote Da a letter saying, "In former years on the southern campaign, before the year

units.zh: （未及）
units.en: (before the year had ended)
units.literal: (not yet reached)

units.zh: [末及]還，適與李鴻會於漢陽，承知消息，慨然永歎，以存足下平素之志，豈徒空托名榮，貴為乘離乎！
units.en: had closed I was still on the road; I met Li Hong at Hanyang and learned your mind. I sighed long for the loyalty you have always shown—surely you do not seek empty glory while we remain apart!
units.literal: had ended I returned, just then met Li Hong at Hanyang, received and knew your message, sighed long with feeling—thereby to preserve your foot's constant purpose—how merely empty entrusting name and glory, prized as riding estrangement!

units.zh: 嗚呼孟子，斯實劉封侵陵足下，以傷先主待士之義。
units.en: Alas, Meng Da—it was Liu Feng’s bullying that wronged you and violated the late emperor’s duty to his men.
units.literal: Alas, Mengzi, this truly was Liu Feng encroaching and bullying you, thereby harming the First Sovereign's righteousness in treating gentlemen.

units.zh: 又鴻道王沖造作虛語，云足下量度吾心，不受沖說。
units.en: Li Hong also said Wang Chong’s story was invented, and he praised you for seeing my true intent and rejecting the lie.
units.literal: Again Hong related that Wang Chong fabricated empty words, saying you measured my mind and did not accept Chong's tale.

units.zh: 尋表明之言，追平生之好，依依東望，故遣有書。」
units.en: Clarifying what was declared above, pursuing the friendship of a lifetime, lingering as I gaze east—I therefore send this letter."
units.literal: Clarifying what was declared above, pursuing the friendship of a lifetime, lingering as I gaze east—I therefore send this letter."

units.zh: 達得亮書，數相交通，辭欲叛魏。
units.en: Meng Da answered repeatedly and began plotting to revolt from Wei.
units.literal: When Da obtained Liang's letter, repeatedly exchanged communication, declared intent wishing to rebel against Wei.

units.zh: 魏遣司馬宣王征之，即斬滅達。
units.en: Wei sent Sima Yi against him and had him killed at once.
units.literal: Wei sent Sima the King of Xuan to campaign against him; at once beheaded and destroyed Da.

units.zh: 亮亦以達無款誠之心，故不救助也。
units.en: Zhuge Liang did not send help because he judged Meng Da insincere.
units.literal: Liang also because Da had no sincere and honest heart, therefore did not rescue and aid.

units.zh: 蔣琬秉政，以詩為諫議大夫，卒於家。
units.en: Under Jiang Wan’s regency Fei Shi became grandee remonstrant and died at home.
units.literal: Jiang Wan held government, appointed Shi grandee remonstrant; he died at home.

units.zh: 王沖者，廣漢人也。
units.en: Wang Chong was from Guanghan.
units.literal: Wang Chong was a man of Guanghan.

units.zh: 為牙門將，統屬江州李嚴。
units.en: He was a camp-gate general under Li Yan of Jiangzhou.
units.literal: He was camp-gate general, commanded under Jiangzhou Li Yan.

units.zh: 為嚴所疾，懼罪降魏。
units.en: Li Yan disliked him, so fearing punishment he defected to Wei.
units.literal: Yan was jealous of him; fearing punishment he surrendered to Wei.

units.zh: 魏以沖為樂陵太守。
units.en: Wei made him governor of Leling.
units.literal: Wei appointed Chong Administrator of Leling.

units.zh: 〈孙盛蜀世谱曰：诗子立，晋散骑常侍。
units.en: 〈Sun Sheng’s Shu genealogy records Fei Shi’s son Li as a Jin gentleman attendant at leisure.
units.literal: 〈Sun Sheng's Shu shìpu states: Shi's son Li, Jin gentleman attendant at leisure.

units.zh: 自后益州诸费有名位者，多是诗之后也。〉
units.en: Most later Fei clansmen of note in Yizhou descended from him.〉
units.literal: From afterward Yizhou's various Fei who had fame and position were mostly Shi's posterity.〉

units.zh: 评曰：霍峻孤城不倾，王连固节不移，向朗好学不倦，张裔肤敏应机，杨洪乃心忠公，费诗率意而言，皆有可纪焉。
units.en: The historian’s judgment: Huo Jun held a lone city; Wang Lian kept faith; Xiang Lang never tired of study; Zhang Yi was quick and resourceful; Yang Hong was utterly loyal; Fei Shi spoke his mind—all merit remembrance.
units.literal: The appraisal states: Huo Jun's lone city did not topple; Wang Lian's firm integrity did not shift; Xiang Lang loved learning without weariness; Zhang Yi was perceptive and keen, responding to opportunity; Yang Hong's heart was loyal to the ducal; Fei Shi spoke following his mind—all had what is worth recording.

units.zh: 以先主之广济，诸葛之准绳，诗吐直言，犹用陵迟，况庸后乎哉！
units.en: Yet even Liu Bei’s generosity and Zhuge Liang’s fairness could not save Fei Shi from demotion for blunt speech—what hope for lesser lords thereafter?
units.literal: Given the First Sovereign's broad succor, Zhuge's marking cord—Shi spat forth straight words, still was used declining—how much more vulgar successors!
